name: Sea Gremlin
text:
You're a creature of the water, and it's while you're in the water that you feel most comfortable. If you have the fuath gremlin heritage, you gain a swim Speed of 15 feet. If you have the haniver gremlin heritage, your swim Speed increases to 25 feet.

---
Special If you're a fuath, you can take this feat a second time to increase your swim Speed to 25 feet.
